items.title: Hilda Taylor Interview, 1960-10-16
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Everything. Man Perez. Man Perez. He and Man Perez had nothing trouble playing around there.

ctx.x: Scales, always before he started to play anything, he'd run his scales all the time. And he did the same thing with his students and that. They had to do that scale work. In other words, he said you just can't keep up without your scale work. Right. He could run those scales and triple tongue. I used to love to hear him play High Society. Did you ever hear him play that? Yeah.
Everything. Man Perez. Man Perez. He and Man Perez had nothing trouble playing around there. He could play the High Society and make the clarinet. You remember Sidney Bean?
Oh, yeah. He played the clarinet. He died too. He was a very good clarinet.
